What I Do

Services

End-to-end SEO services for brands that want real organic growth, not just rankings on a report.

Technical SEO & Site Audits
Deep-dive audits covering crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, site speed, structured data, and architecture. I find what’s broken and fix it — from complex JavaScript rendering issues to orphan pages and redirect chains.
E-Commerce SEO
Product feed optimization, category architecture, internal linking, and shopping tab listings across Shopify, Salla, Zid, and WooCommerce. I turn product catalogs into organic traffic machines.
AEO & GEO (AI Visibility)
Optimization for AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. I audit how your brand appears in AI answers and build citable content structure, entity consistency, schema markup, and llms.txt so AI engines quote you.
Programmatic SEO
Template-based page generation at scale. I design data-driven landing page systems that create hundreds or thousands of optimized pages targeting long-tail keywords automatically.
Arabic & Multilingual SEO
Native Arabic keyword research and content strategy that goes beyond translation. I understand how Arabic speakers actually search — across dialects, intent patterns, and regional differences in Egypt, KSA, and UAE.
Analytics, Reporting & PPC
GA4, Search Console, Looker Studio dashboards, and Google Ads management. I connect organic sessions to revenue so you see sales impact, not just ranking charts.
Track Record

Key Achievements

Real problems solved. Not just traffic up — sites saved, rebuilt, and scaled.

Hacked Site Recovery

Recovered a site that was completely compromised — cleaned malware, removed spam injections, submitted reconsideration requests, and restored rankings from zero back to pre-hack levels.

Complex Technical SEO Fixes

Took on sites with severe technical issues — broken JavaScript rendering, crawl budget waste, thousands of orphan pages — and rebuilt them into clean, crawlable architectures that Google actually indexes.

Site Migrations Done Right

Managed full site migrations (domain changes, platform moves, URL restructuring) with proper redirect mapping, preserving link equity and traffic through the transition.

Programmatic SEO at Scale

Built programmatic page systems generating hundreds of optimized landing pages from structured data, targeting long-tail keywords that manual content could never cover.

345% Traffic Growth in 3 Months

Took an e-commerce store from 1.85K to 8.24K organic clicks and 107K to 496K impressions in a single quarter through combined technical and content optimization.

Zero to Organic Visibility

Launched organic presence for multiple Saudi brands from absolute zero — no history, no backlinks, no content — and built them into sites pulling thousands of monthly organic clicks.
